title: INTEL-030 — Block Intelligence Model: DRI Field + Morning Briefing + Enterprise Pitch
description: INTEL-030 action items from Jack/Sequoia Block essay. Formalize DRI field in sprint JSON, build Harvey morning briefing foundation, update TICKET-034 Enterprise Deploy pitch. Source: INTEL-030.

tasks.title: Add DRI field to sprint JSON schema and brief generator
tasks.context:
Add a 'dri' (Directly Responsible Individual) field to the sprint JSON format. In the brief generator script (scripts/generate-sprint-brief.ts), ensure every generated sprint brief includes:

1. A 'dri' field in the sprint JSON (string, agent name — e.g. 'MacGyver', 'Harvey', 'Sherlock')
2. A 'dri_ownership_days' field (number, default 90 — per Block's DRI model)
3. A 'resource_pull_authority' field (boolean, default true — DRI can spawn subagents)

This maps Block's three-role model to Kognai: ICs = named agents, DRIs = sprint-assigned leads, Player-Coaches = Harvey.

If generate-sprint-brief.ts does not exist, look for the nearest equivalent in scripts/ that generates sprint JSON files and modify that instead.

tasks.title: Create Harvey morning briefing foundation script
tasks.context:
Create scripts/harvey-morning-briefing.ts — Harvey's intelligence layer morning briefing generator.

This script runs daily at 08:30 and composes:
1. Read the last 24h of sprint results from workspace/sprints/*.json (filter by date)
2. Count: tasks completed, tasks rejected, CTO proposals, supervisor conflicts
3. Read pending items from workspace/sprint-queue.json (top 10 by priority)
4. Read any new daily report from reports/swarm-runs/
5. Check PM2 process status by reading ecosystem.config.js
6. Compose a structured briefing JSON:

{
  date: string,
  sprint_velocity: { completed: number, rejected: number, pending: number },
  top_priority_items: Array<{id: string, title: string, priority: string}>,
  system_health: { pm2_online: number, pm2_stopped: number },
  intelligence_signals: string[], // from latest INTEL briefs
  recommended_actions: string[] // Harvey's top 3 recommendations
}

Write output to workspace/briefings/YYYY-MM-DD-morning.json.

Use only Node built-ins (fs, path). No LLM calls — this is a data aggregation script, not a generation script.
